finding.title: The `handler_invoked` variable is a `volatile bool` which is not sufficient to ensure atomicity. If the signal handler is invoked while the parent process is checking the `handler_invoked` variable, it could lead to a race condition.
The child process sends a signal to the parent process. If the parent process is not ready to handle the signal, it could lead to undefined behavior.

The parent process sets up a second signal handler to test if the first was reset. However, the `raise(SIGINT)` call in the parent process could lead to a race condition if the signal handler is not properly synchronized.
